_readme: The giraffes, and everything they say. This is the file to rewrite.
Walk up to one and a prompt appears; press E (or tap TALK) for their next
line, and again for the one after.
Five of them ask for a favour, one per zone, and a zone won't let you past
until its favour is done — so nothing can be missed and come back to bite
you at the end. The other four are just people who live here.
QUEST SHAPES
fetch    — go and get `item`, bring it back to whoever asked
deliver  — carry `item` from the giver to the giraffe named in `to`
talk     — no object; the conversation is the whole thing
WHAT EACH LIST IS FOR
offer    — first time you talk to them, and how the favour is asked for
nudge    — talking to them again while you're still doing it
done     — the hand-in (on `deliver` this belongs to the receiver)
receive  — a `deliver` target's lines when you hand the thing over
idle     — anything after their favour is finished, cycling
lines    — for giraffes with no favour at all; cycles forever
`at` is where they stand: [x, y, z]. `outfit` is from OUTFITS in
js/giraffe.js: topHat, partyHat, beanie, sunHat, flowerCrown, glasses,
shades, scarf, bowTie, sweater, cape, backpack. `loop` is how wide a circle
they wander in — trimmed automatically if it would walk them into a wall.
gateNudge: {name} is still waiting on something back that way.

people.name: Juniper

quest.task: Get Juniper's blanket down off the roof
offer: Oh — you're here. You're actually here. I've swept.
Sorry. I practised that and it came out odd.
Small favour, while you're on your feet: my picnic blanket's gone up onto the roof. There was a wind. It was a whole thing.
Marlow says I should just get a new blanket. Marlow has opinions about blankets now, apparently.
nudge: It's the red one, up on the house. You can't miss it, it's being very smug about the view.
done: You got it! Look at it. Barely any moss on it at all.
Sit with me a minute? You've come a long way and the tea's still warm.

idle: Todd built this whole place for you, you know. With Claude — I don't know what that is, but he was very pleased with himself.
He moved that little house four times. Four! Said it wasn't right yet.
Go and find Marlow if you'd like to be cheered at. He's very good at it. It's mostly what he does.

people.name: Marlow
lines: Morning! Lovely day. They're all lovely here, but this one especially — you turned up.
Pip's been wearing a party hat for three days in case he missed you. Three days. I admire the commitment and I worry about the neck.
Bertrand's laid out a buffet up on the cliff. Nobody asked him to. Nobody has ever asked him to.
I moved out here to be nearer my sister, actually. Packed up the whole life. Best thing I ever did, and I'd do it again tomorrow.
Anyway — don't let me keep you. Actually do, a bit. It's nice.

people.name: Wendell
lines: What if his name was Jeremy Seinfeld?
No, that's it. That's the whole thought.
I've been out here a while.

people.name: Pip

quest.task: Take Pip's invitation up to Clementine in the woods
offer: HI. Hello. Hi. I've had this hat on for three days in case you turned up.
Worth it. No regrets. Slight neck thing.
Okay okay okay — I'm throwing a party, and I need somebody to run an invitation up to Clementine in the woods.
I'd go myself, but if I leave the creek I might miss you arriving. Which you've now done. But still.
nudge: Clementine! Up in the woods! She's the one with all the cats round her!

idle: SHE SAID YES? She said yes. I need to sit down. I need to stand up. I need to do both.
There's going to be bunting. I haven't made the bunting yet. There's going to be bunting.
You'll come, won't you? You don't have to say yes. You've said yes. I heard it.

people.name: Clementine
receive: Oh — a party! From Pip? He throws one every year. It's always lovely and there's never any food.
Tell him yes. Tell him I'll bring something with food in it.

quest.task: Get Clementine's cat down from the tall tree
offer: While you're up here — could you do me a kindness? One of the cats has gone up the big tree again.
They're not mine. Technically. I just feed them. Every day. And named them all. And worry about them constantly.
It's the grey one. She knows exactly what she's doing.
nudge: Top of the tallest tree. She's fine. She's smug. She's fine and she's smug.
done: Oh, come here, you daft animal. Look at her — not even slightly sorry.
Thank you. Really. You've got a way with difficult creatures. That'll serve you well round here.

idle: Mind your step in the trees, it goes dim. Beautiful though, isn't it.
That's her third tree this month. I've stopped counting out loud, it upsets me.
If you're heading for the coast, Bertrand's up on the cliff. Be kind. He's been practising.

people.name: Bertrand

quest.task: Find Bertrand's fig down on the shore
offer: Ah. The sister. Genuinely delighted, and I do not say that lightly.
I have laid out a buffet. It is, if I say so myself, magnificent. It is also missing precisely one thing.
A single ripe fig. There is a tree down on the shore. I would fetch it myself, but I am — as you can see — presiding.
nudge: The fig tree. Down on the shore. I shall be here. Presiding.
done: Ah! There. Look at it. That is a fig of consequence.
You may consider yourself the guest of honour. You are also the only guest. That is not the point and I'd thank you not to raise it.

idle: The view from up here is the finest in the world. He built it that way on purpose, I'm told.
Odie sleeps through most of this. I've stopped taking it personally. Largely.
Do go up to Sage when you're ready. She's been waiting longer than any of us.

people.name: Odie
lines: Hey. Oh — hey. Sorry, I was doing a nap. I do a lot of naps.
Cool cactus, right? I like to think the two of us match.
I'm saving up for a bit of land. Just a patch. Down past the rocks where it's quiet.
Nothing fancy. Some grass. Room for a few things to grow. I think about it a lot.
...Did I already say the land thing? I say the land thing a lot. It's fine. It's a good thing to say.

people.name: Winnifred
lines: Oh — hello! Don't stand near the edge. Sorry. You're fine. I'm fine. We're all fine.
Yes, I live up here. I know. I KNOW.
The rent is very reasonable, the neighbours are lovely, and I have not looked down once since I arrived.
Sage is right at the top and it doesn't bother her at all. I find that annoying and also aspirational.
Go on up. I'd come with you, but I would genuinely rather do anything else.

people.name: Sage

quest.task: Go all the way up and find Sage
offer: You're a long way up. Nobody comes this high without a reason.
I've been writing a song about this place. Years, now.
Would you like to hear it? It isn't finished. I should say that first.
♪ It's a giraffe world ♪
...that's the line.
That's the whole thing. That's all I've got. I've had it ten years.
Everyone tells me it's my best work. I don't know how to feel about that.
done: Sit a minute. The stars come out properly up here.
Thank you for coming all this way. I've been looking forward to it more than I know how to say.
Before you go — look up. The long one there, with the tail. That's Luna.
She's been up there a good while now. Somebody put her where she'd be easy to find.
Go on. Go and say hello.

idle: Everyone below is talking about you, and every word of it is kind.
That doesn't happen often. I'd hold onto it.
Go on. Go and see what he made for you.
